title: Legal Associate
description:
Who we are :
Money. A subject that’s always on our mind. We go through a rollercoaster of emotions when it comes to money. That’s why at Jupiter, our mission is to enable people to improve their relationship with money.

We are a financial services platform that leverages technology to offer our customers seamless and user-friendly products related to banking, loans, and investments. So whether it’s a savings account, credit cards, investment and payments, it's all on Jupiter. We also help users cut through the banking jargons, offer smart insights based on spending and provide users with a range of new age features to enable and make sense of their finances.

Our journey so far:
Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea : to create a modern, customer-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.

From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter - and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2.8 million + happy users on Jupiter.

Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.

We've embraced cutting-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like-minded folks to join the crew.

Who we're looking for
This is a hands on role supporting the Legal and Compliance function across the group, with day to day ownership of contracting, regulatory tracking and secretarial support. The person will work directly with the Head of Legal and Compliance and will interface with product, business, alliances, finance, risk, the group Company Secretaries and external counsel.


Roles & Responsibilities
  • Draft, review and close commercial contracts on standard templates, including vendor and service agreements, NDAs, SaaS and technology agreements, alliance, affiliate and DSA agreements, addenda and statements of work, escalating non standard positions.
  • Run high-volume, low complexity documentation with committed turnaround, including payout and commercial addenda, renewals and campaign documentation.
  • Maintain the contract repository, tracker and version control, and drive renewals, expiries and closure of open points.
  • Track RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, NPCI and IFSCA circulars and amendments relevant to the group and prepare summaries and impact notes.
  • Assist with regulatory filings, audit and inspection observations, policy updates and internal compliance trackers.
  • Coordinate legal notices, consumer forum matters and grievance escalations with external counsel, including preparing case briefs and collating records.
  • Support corporate secretarial work for group entities: board and committee meeting logistics, notices, agendas, minutes, resolutions, statutory registers, MCA filings and annual filings.

Exposure the role offers

The role sits across the full spread of the group's legal and regulatory work and offers direct exposure, working alongside the Head of Legal and Compliance, to:
  • Lending and borrowing documentation for the NBFC across the lender stack, including term loans, NCDs, co-lending, DLG and sourcing arrangements.
  • Payments and PPI work, including bank and network arrangements, escrow structures, NPCI and card network requirements and the co-branded card ecosystem.
  • Regulatory correspondence, inspections, audits, and license and authorization applications across RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, NPCI and IFSCA.
  • Product counseling on new launches, customer-facing terms, key fact statements, disclosures and marketing collateral.
  • Data protection and information security workstreams under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and RBI outsourcing and IT governance frameworks.
  • Board and committee-level advisory, governance, and policy frameworks across the group entities.
  • Diligence during fundraises and corporate transactions.

What is needed for this role

  • LL.B. or LL.M. from a recognized university.
  • 2 to 3 years of experience in an in-house legal team of a bank, NBFC, fintech, or payments company, or in a law firm with a financial services or technology practice.
  • Hands-on drafting and redlining ability in commercial contracts, with clear reasoning on risk and fallback positions.
  • Working knowledge of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, the Companies Act, 2013, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
  • Strong written English, structured thinking, attention to detail and comfort with high volume work under deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently with business stakeholders and to escalate the right issues at the right time.

Good to have

  • Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI), or CS Professional cleared.
  • Practical exposure to MCA filings on the V2 and V3 portals, board and general meeting processes and statutory registers.
  • Familiarity with at least one regulated financial services framework, for example the RBI frameworks on prepaid payment instruments, digital lending, KYC or NBFC scale based regulation.
  • Exposure to payments, cards, UPI or NPCI circulars, or to insurance broking or investment advisory regulations.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management or a legal repository system.

Why you should work with us
  • We like people who behave like owners and see projects through to completion.
  • We take pleasure in tackling meaningful problems and crafting delightful customer experiences.
  • We appreciate healthy conflict, ownership, and commitment—we value consent over consensus.
  • We constantly raise the bar. If you crave continuous learning and growth, Jupiter is the right place.

title: Sr Manager
description:
Our journey so far
Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea: to create a modern, customer-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.

From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter - and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2.8 million+ happy users on Jupiter.

Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.
We've embraced cutting-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like-minded folks to join the crew.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Manager/Sr Manager – Fraud Operations (Customer Support) to lead a team of Fraud Analysts who are responsible for managing fraud-related customer interactions across inbound calls, emails, and chats. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in fraud investigations, customer support operations, stakeholder management, team leadership, and process improvement within the banking or fintech ecosystem. This role requires a balance of operational excellence, people management, customer-centricity, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
    • Lead and manage a team of 9–10 Fraud Analysts, ensuring timely, accurate, and high-quality resolution of fraud-related customer queries across calls, emails, and chat channels.
    • Investigate suspicious transactions, account freezes, financial crime alerts, and potential fraud cases using internal fraud monitoring tools and risk indicators.
    • Review and recommend decisions related to account restrictions, account unfreezing, lien removal, and account closures in accordance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and partner bank guidelines.
    • Coordinate with partner banks, vendors (e.g., Freshdesk, Jira, Ozonetel), internal stakeholders, Compliance, Risk, Product, Operations, Customer support  and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) to facilitate fraud investigations and regulatory requests.
    • Handle high-priority customer escalations while ensuring professional, empathetic, and policy-compliant communication.
    • Monitor and drive operational performance against key metrics, including SLA adherence, productivity, quality, CSAT, First Response Time (FRT), Average Handling Time (AHT), and Turnaround Time (TAT).
    • Conduct quality audits, provide coaching and regular performance feedback, and mentor team members to improve productivity, quality, and customer experience.
    • Develop, review, and continuously enhance fraud investigation processes, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), knowledge articles, and customer support workflows.
    • Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and management presentations on fraud trends, operational performance, productivity, and key business metrics.
    • Drive automation initiatives and continuous process improvements to reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and enhance investigation accuracy.
    • Manage critical fraud incidents and ensure timely communication, escalation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
    • Support workforce planning, capacity management, scheduling, and resource allocation to meet business requirements and service levels.
    • Analyse fraud trends and identify opportunities to strengthen fraud prevention controls by collaborating with Risk, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Data Analytics teams.
    • Ensure adherence to RBI guidelines, AML/KYC regulations, NPCI guidelines, internal policies, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
Requirements
    • Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university. A postgraduate qualification (MBA or equivalent) is preferred.
    • 5–6 years of experience in Fraud Operations, AML, Customer Support, Risk Operations, Financial Crime, or Fraud Investigations within the Banking or Fintech industry.
    • Minimum 3–4 years of experience leading teams in a Team Lead or Assistant Manager capacity.
    • Proven experience managing customer support operations and fraud Prevention teams in a high-volume environment.
    • Strong understanding of fraud operations, transaction monitoring, customer profiling, fraud investigation & prevention , Mule accounts, account lifecycle management, and customer risk assessment.
    • Experience handling Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) requests, partner bank coordination, regulatory compliance, and fraud escalations.
    • Hands-on experience with CRM and ticketing platforms such as Freshdesk, Jira, Salesforce, Ozonetel, or similar systems.
    • Excellent analytical and decision-making skills with the ability to investigate complex fraud scenarios and make risk-based decisions.
    • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, dashboards, reporting), Microsoft PowerPoint, and operational MIS reporting.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication, coaching, and people management skills.
    • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume operational environment while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance.
    • Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and conflict-resolution abilities.
Preferred Skills
    • Experience in Digital Banking, UPI, IMPS, NEFT/RTGS, card fraud, payment fraud, account takeover (ATO), mule account investigations, and cyber fraud operations.
    • Exposure to fraud detection systems, workflow automation, operational excellence initiatives, and AI-driven fraud monitoring tools.
    • Working knowledge of RBI regulations, AML/KYC requirements, NPCI guidelines, customer dispute management, and financial crime compliance.
    • Experience driving process improvement initiatives and implementing operational best practices.
